title: Add deterministic UV charting and a procedural paint atlas for creature skin
description:
## Summary
Replace baked per-vertex triplanar appearance with a deterministic UV charter and a procedural paint pass into an atlas. Object-space triplanar mapping is locked to the rest pose, so the pattern stretches under skinning. Baked vertex color also cannot express the painted skin this project needs.

Evidence: `docs/audits/creaturecreator-spore-metaball-pivot-and-appearance-synthesis-2026-09-12.md`, findings F-03, F-04, F-05, section 11. Spore evidence: Chris Hecker, "My Liner Notes for Spore" (charter algorithm, about 10 ms on minimum specification) and Ocean Quigley, "Spore's creature skin painting" (brush splat through 3D to texture positions, landmark-relative paint regions).

## User Mandate
> The triplanar shader we have doesn't work with animation, and we really need the painting texture mapping tech.

STRICT. Captured verbatim. Do not relax or re-scope.

## Scope
- Implement the documented charter: pick an uncharted triangle, flood to neighbours facing approximately the same cardinal direction, project the group flat onto that axis plane, then sort charts by bounding box and pack the boxes in 2D texture space in a zig-zag manner.
- Change one detail for determinism. Spore started on a random uncharted triangle. Use the lowest canonical triangle index instead.
- Dilate the atlas to prevent bilinear and mipmap seams.
- Add a procedural paint pass that writes at least an albedo channel into the atlas. Add specular, gloss, and normal channels only when a task requires them.
- Paint by morphology-relative region, not by bone index. Reuse `PartType` and normalized limb arc length for spine, limb, proximal, and distal. Use the body frame sign for dorsal and ventral.
- Stop driving surface mapping from `TriplanarNoise`. Keep it only as an optional pattern source if a task needs one.
- Retire the `Triplanar` and position-driven nodes in `Assets/Shaders/VertexLit.shadergraph` and sample by UV instead.
- Coordinate with `TSK-0064` and `ADR-003` on material ownership. `BuildSkinningMeshCopy` already preserves UV0 to UV2, so the binding path already carries the channel.
- Feeds TSK-0225, which needs UV-preserving decimation for runtime tiers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A deformation test animates one limb and asserts each vertex texture coordinate is unchanged while vertex positions change.
- A material test asserts that no object-space or world-space position node feeds texture sampling.
- A determinism test charts one definition twice and asserts identical UV assignment and identical atlas layout.
- Every chart is a planar projection onto one cardinal axis, so distortion is bounded.
- Paint regions resolve for spine, limb, proximal, distal, dorsal, and ventral on a multi-limb fixture.
- Generation of the committed tier produces a mesh with UV0 populated and a dilating margin.
- Total charter time is measured and recorded. Spore's reported target is about 10 ms on its minimum specification.

## Validation
Unity EditMode and PlayMode plus `dotnet build`. Add the UV determinism test, the animation-stability test, and the material node test. Inspect one generated atlas and one painted creature in the editor. Record charter and paint duration per stage. Source inspection alone cannot close this task.

## Findings
- Today `AppearanceBaker.Bake` writes one `Color` per vertex from part `BaseColor` and `TriplanarNoise.Evaluate`. `TriplanarNoise` evaluates in object space from position and normal.
- `Assets/Shaders/VertexLit.shadergraph` contains `TriplanarNode` and `PositionNode` nodes.
- Spore accepted wasted texels and many seams to obtain bounded distortion and about 10 ms charting.
- Spore's paint system was procedural. Particles ran in barycentric coordinates on the surface and used landmark targets such as the spine, halfway up the legs, the head, the tail, the belly, and the arms.
- Re-extraction per level-of-detail would need a new chart per level. Decimating the charted mesh preserves UVs.

## Blockers
- The paint region vocabulary must be defined once and shared. Do not create a second anatomy vocabulary beside `PartType`.

## Next Step
Implement the charter and prove deterministic UV assignment on one fixture. Then add the dilate step and a single albedo paint pass before touching the shader.
